note: The private half of tests/data/rematch_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the rematch of a lobby room for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'): the reserved seats of net::HostLobby against test_lobby N4.41 - N4.49d, the room manager's rematch against test_server S3.194 - S3.203 (the restart record of a code that comes back: S3.203), the game's word to its page against test_network_app N5.98 - N5.99 and the results' two buttons ("Back to the room", "Back to Ants & Uncles": which seat each keeps or gives up) against N5.105, and the pages (web/front/rematch.js, lobby_net.js, lobby_rules.js) against tests/scripts/web_rematch_check.js, web_lobby_rules_check.js, web_lobby_client_check.js and web_lobby_net_check.js, and the room that /?hostmap=<file name> opens on a map of the library. Run from the checkout with a configured build folder: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/rematch_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 2. Every mutant must be caught; tests/scripts/test_web_rematch.py runs the pages' ones (those with no build) in the quick tier on a copy of the files.
